source: ParkScoop wait log (ThemeParks.wiki posted standby waits, logged every 15 minutes during park hours; posted waits, not true walk time). Disneyland Resort hours are Pacific.
method: per clock-hour median of operating posted waits; hour shown when ≥3 distinct days or ≥6 checks; bestHour = lowest qualifying median; usual = overall median; vsUsual = live − this hour's median
tzNote: Log timestamps are America/New_York; Disneyland Resort buckets use America/Los_Angeles (ET−3).
